title: Celebrity British hairstylist John Frieda dies aged 75
summary: British celebrity hairstylist and beauty industry stalwart John Frieda, who tended to the locks of Jackie Kennedy and Princess Diana among others, has died aged 75, his salon announced on Tuesday, November 3. "It is with heavy hearts that we share the news that our dear John passed away peacefully... surrounded by his family," the John Frieda salon posted on Instagram. "John was more than a mentor to us; he was a true icon of the hair industry. He was the person who taught us everything,... - Industry buzz
